floorPlans.note: Four complete official brochure sheets show five home categories. Studio and 1 BR pool drawings share one sheet. Separate sheets show 2 BR, 1 BR duplex and 2 BR duplex pool homes, with both duplex levels retained. The 2 BR duplex includes a labeled maid room. Ten complete building floorplates from Petkovic Properties’ branded broker mirror cover floors 1–10. Numerical home areas and contractual numbered-unit matching are not printed. The historical 1 BR duplex appears in the brochure but is omitted from the current primary’s category list. Confirm the chosen home, area and current availability with SAMANA.

additionalDocuments.label: SAMANA California 2 · original official brochure and home drawings

review.imagery: Twenty-three own-project renders cover the complete building, stepped private pools, shared deck, podium gardens/play area, lobby, gym and home interiors. All 57 native resources and six primary gallery files were visually reviewed against the whole brochure index. Blank masks, line/rectangle resources, source compositing fragments, the New York bridge photograph and generic people/travel scenes are excluded. The complete primary building render supplies the card and hero. Native source-baked captions and marks remain intact. No kitchen render is claimed.
review.floorPlans: Four complete official brochure sheets show five home categories. Studio and 1 BR pool drawings share one sheet. Separate sheets show 2 BR, 1 BR duplex and 2 BR duplex pool homes, with both duplex levels retained. The 2 BR duplex includes a labeled maid room. Ten complete building floorplates from Petkovic Properties’ branded broker mirror cover floors 1–10. Numerical home areas and contractual numbered-unit matching are not printed. The historical 1 BR duplex appears in the brochure but is omitted from the current primary’s category list. Confirm the chosen home, area and current availability with SAMANA. All four complete official drawing sheets 31–34 and all ten mirror floorplates 2–11 were visually reviewed. The studio and 1 BR page is preserved in full. Both duplex levels, stairs, labeled stores and maid room are retained. Mirror floor 1 retains its gym legend and floors 9–10 retain their duplex legends. No room dimension or whole-floor total is converted into a home area.
review.location: Complete physical page 35 map and historical page 36 travel panel were visually reviewed. Current-primary eight-destination ranges supply the cards. Conflicting historical Burj Khalifa, Ibn Battuta and Marina estimates are explicit. Historical airport wording and broad Downtown label are qualified. The published name-only map query retains the primary HTML hash. No entrance coordinate or exact plot frontage is inferred.
review.provenance: Official primary HTML and brochure, native render origins and Petkovic’s complete branded floorplate PDF have receipts and SHA256 checks. Broker hosting remains explicitly labeled. Full source content, original PDF bytes and physical page links are preserved. Protected identity and completed text research remain intact.

unavailable: Drawing-specific numerical home areas, contractual numbered-unit matching, resolution of historical/current travel conflicts, current 1 BR duplex availability, exact visitor entrance coordinates, final unit views/finishes and dated construction photographs were not established.
